reason: The README describes an agent tool that searches the dsh.so registry for matching plugins and presents metadata and installation commands, making search and browsing its primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 通过自然语言搜索 dsh.so 插件注册表，并返回匹配插件的描述、验证与风险信息、详情链接及安装命令。
summaries.en: Search the dsh.so plugin registry using natural language and receive matching plugin descriptions, verification and risk information, detail links, and installation commands.

capabilities: Registers an agent tool for natural-language plugin searches
Fetches and searches the dsh.so plugin index
Returns plugin metadata, verification and risk information, detail links, and installation commands
